land_pattern.package: SO-14 (ST 'D' plastic micropackage), section 5.3, Figure 25 + Table 6
land_pattern.notes: NO RECOMMENDED LAND PATTERN IS PUBLISHED for SO-14 in this datasheet. Section 5.3 gives ONLY the package mechanical drawing (Figure 25) and the mechanical data table (Table 6) - the datasheet's only 'footprint recommendation' drawing is Figure 24, and that is for the QFN16 3x3 package, NOT for SO-14. The pitch above is grounded: Table 6 'e' = 1.27 mm typ (0.05 in) lead pitch. pad_size_mm and row_spacing_mm are DELIBERATELY OMITTED because the PDF does not state them - derive them from a standard IPC-7351 SOIC127P600X175-14N land pattern, not from this file. Package outline dimensions available for that derivation (Table 6, mm): body D 8.55-8.75 x E 3.80-4.00, lead span H 5.80-6.20, lead width B 0.33-0.51, lead thickness C 0.19-0.25, foot length L 0.40-1.27, standoff A1 0.10-0.25, overall height A 1.35-1.75, lead angle k 8 deg max, coplanarity ddd 0.10 max. Figure 25's bottom view numbers pin 1 at the top-left with pins 1-7 along one side and 8-14 along the other (14 opposite 1).
